9a2c3fdc2d92c2b9.description: About Jazera Arabia Contracting Jazera Arabia Contracting is seeking a qualified Civil Engineer to join their team in Ha'il, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires a professional with substantial experience in civil engineering projects, particularly within infrastructure development. Role Overview The Civil Engineer will be responsible for the execution and management of various infrastructure projects, focusing on roads, bridges, and wadi infrastructure. The role involves overseeing project management, maintenance works, and ensuring compliance with technical specifications and safety standards. This position is critical for delivering high-quality engineering solutions in the region. Key Responsibilities Manage and execute road, bridge, and wadi infrastructure projects. Oversee project management and maintenance works for civil engineering projects. Lead and manage contractors and site teams effectively. Implement and manage road traffic safety improvement projects. Ensure adherence to technical specifications and road safety standards throughout project lifecycles. Prepare comprehensive reports on project progress and outcomes. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering. Minimum of 5 years of experience in project management and maintenance works. Proven experience in the execution and management of road, bridge, and wadi infrastructure projects. Minimum of 5 years of experience specifically in road traffic safety improvement projects. Strong knowledge of technical specifications and road safety standards. Required Skills Ability to effectively manage projects, contractors, and site teams. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and AutoCAD. Strong planning, organizational, and reporting skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Ha'il, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to significant infrastructure projects within a dynamic contracting environment.

9a5c46432a992e5a.description: About Master-Works Master-Works is a Saudi technology company focused on driving digital transformation through emerging technologies and innovative digital solutions. The company provides expertise in data management, AI, software development, and digital strategy, contributing to the digital economy in line with Saudi Vision 2030. Role Overview Master-Works is seeking a Senior Project Manager to facilitate Agile delivery and lead Scrum ceremonies. This full-time role focuses on driving continuous improvement across development teams, including sprint planning, performance monitoring, Agile coaching, and implementing Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) practices to enhance team collaboration and delivery effectiveness. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Initiate and manage Scrum events for participating squads. Lead the development and implementation of Scaled Agile management best practices. Facilitate daily Scrum meetings and other regular Agile ceremonies. Plan upcoming sprints for projects, ensuring team consensus on achievable goals. Monitor and report on the progress of ongoing sprints. Communicate with Delivery Managers to ensure alignment and provide planning updates. Collect and analyze relevant metrics to identify trends and indicators, facilitate iteration and increment planning, and provide Agile coaching and mentoring across the organization. Collaborate with the leadership team to strategically enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of Agile processes. Establish SAFe Agile principles and coordinate with other departments to ensure clear communication regarding development activities. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar project management role. Leadership and management experience. Certified Scrum Master certification is preferred. Required Skills Strong knowledge of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles and practices. Demonstrated leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to facilitate team collaboration, coach team members, and drive continuous improvement. Strong organizational and planning skills. Application Process Candidates interested in this Senior Project Manager position are encouraged to apply.

9a63c8fe6f891045.description: About the Role HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking a Saudi Engineer to join its client-side program and construction management (PMCM) team in Riyadh. This full-time position is designed for recent graduates or individuals with up to 3 years of experience, offering an opportunity to contribute to a major government land-development and infrastructure program. Program Context The program involves a Lead Developer designing and constructing infrastructure, including roads, water, sewer, storm drainage, power, street lighting, irrigation, landscape, and telecom. As part of the HanmiGlobal team, the Saudi Engineer will be involved in reviewing, supervising, and accepting this work on behalf of the client. The role includes rotations through site supervision, quality, planning, commercial, and technical functions, providing practical PMCM skills under experienced engineers. Key Responsibilities Assist senior engineers and project teams in planning, design, and implementation activities. Support the preparation of engineering drawings, calculations, and documentation. Participate in site visits and assist in monitoring construction progress and quality. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to learn and contribute to project tasks. Engage in training programs and professional development opportunities. Help ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards. Perform technical research and support problem-solving activities as needed. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree recently obtained in Engineering disciplines such as Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or related fields. Fresh graduates or up to 3 years of experience. Strong enthusiasm to learn and develop technical and professional skills. Good communication skills and ability to work in a team environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools; knowledge of engineering software is a plus. Commitment to safety, integrity, and corporate values. Willingness to work on-site and adapt to dynamic project requirements. Application Process We invite qualified Saudi graduates to apply for this opportunity to develop their careers within a significant infrastructure program in Riyadh.

9a672fc66a4d28c5.description: About the Role DHL Global Forwarding is seeking an RCC Specialist to join its team in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing road freight rates and supporting quotation processes within the company's global logistics operations. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Collect, negotiate, and validate transporter rates for domestic KSA and cross-border Road Freight lanes. Maintain rate cards, lane matrices, equipment-based costs, fuel mechanisms, border charges, and accessorial schedules. Check rate validity, capacity assumptions, service scope, payment terms, and exclusions before utilizing supplier offers. Coordinate with Transport Procurement and Operations to obtain competitive rates and alternative supplier options. Update pricing tools and supplier-rate databases promptly following negotiated or market-driven cost changes. Support supplier benchmarking by lane, equipment type, service level, and expected volume. Quotation and Costing Duties Review RFQ and quotation requests for completeness, including origin, destination, shipment profile, volume, frequency, equipment, and service requirements. Prepare accurate cost sheets and customer quotation inputs using validated supplier costs and approved pricing rules. Calculate fuel, tolls, permits, border-related costs, waiting time, customs-related charges, and other applicable accessorials. Coordinate operational feasibility and supplier capacity with Operations and Procurement before finalizing costs. Meet agreed turnaround times for tenders, RFQs, and spot quotations, escalating missing inputs or exceptional risks early. Maintain quotation versions, supplier offers, assumptions, approvals, and final submission records. About DHL Global Forwarding DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) is the air, ocean, and road freight specialist within DHL Group, operating in over 220 countries worldwide. The company provides standardized transport and specialized end-to-end solutions to customers across various industries globally. DHL Global Forwarding is part of Deutsche Post DHL, a leading logistics provider. Company Culture and Values DHL Global Forwarding is committed to fostering a positive work environment and supporting employee development. The company holds a TOP EMPLOYER certification, recognizing its efforts to attract and retain talent. Key values include Respect & Results, with a mission of Excellence. Simply Delivered. The organization is an equal opportunity employer, evaluating qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

9a6d7110c50ca153.description: About the Role Alkaffary Group is seeking a Legal Coordinator to manage and follow up on the company's legal affairs. This part-time position involves coordinating legal documentation, monitoring cases and claims, and ensuring compliance with Saudi Arabian laws and regulations. The role is performed on a part-time basis according to an agreed working schedule. Key Responsibilities Follow up on legal cases, disputes, and claims involving the company. Coordinate with external lawyers, legal consultants, and relevant authorities. Prepare and organize documents and supporting evidence for legal proceedings. Monitor court hearing dates, legal deadlines, and case updates. Maintain updated records of ongoing legal matters. Assist in preparing and reviewing contracts and legal agreements, coordinating approvals with relevant departments. Monitor contract expiration dates, renewals, and terminations. Maintain organized and confidential records of legal documents. Monitor relevant changes in Saudi laws and regulations and assist in ensuring company compliance. Follow up on legal notices, violations, and official correspondence. Identify potential legal risks and report them to management. Coordinate legal transactions with government and judicial authorities, including following up on cases and requests through platforms like Najiz. Prepare official letters and legal correspondence. Monitor the implementation of legal decisions and required procedures. Coordinate with the HR Department regarding labor disputes and employee-related legal matters. Prepare and organize documents related to employment contracts, warnings, investigations, and terminations. Follow up on labor complaints and claims and support the preparation of legal documentation for disciplinary procedures. Prepare periodic reports on legal cases, claims, contracts, and pending matters. Maintain accurate and updated legal records and ensure confidentiality of all company legal information. Complete assigned legal tasks within required deadlines and perform other related duties as assigned by management. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, or a related field. Completion of legal training or currently undergoing training at a licensed law firm. 0-1 years of experience is required for this role. Good knowledge of Saudi labor and commercial laws. Familiarity with Saudi government and legal platforms. Required Skills Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Ability to handle confidential information professionally. Work Environment and Expectations This is a part-time position, with working hours determined by mutual agreement based on the company's operational requirements. The Legal Coordinator performs administrative and legal coordination duties. Providing independent legal opinions or representing the company before courts is subject to applicable professional licensing requirements and company authorization. The employee must ensure timely follow-up on assigned legal matters and meet all applicable deadlines, maintaining accuracy and completeness of legal documentation, and providing regular updates on pending legal matters. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

9a72a07c988737be.description: About the Role SNME Anipsotiki is seeking an HSSE Manager (Health, Safety, Security & Environment) to lead all health, safety, security, and environmental activities for SNA crane and installation scopes. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and Shaqra', Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in the field. The role focuses on ensuring that all operations, including lifting, working-at-height tasks, and WTG installation, are planned, controlled, and executed with zero harm to people, equipment, and the environment. Role Purpose and Context The HSSE Manager is responsible for ensuring full compliance with Owner Safety Specifications, client requirements, and Saudi regulations across all project activities. This involves a strong focus on proactive safety measures and continuous oversight to maintain high standards of health, safety, security, and environmental protection throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain the project HSSE Plan, Emergency Response Plan, and supporting procedures, ensuring alignment with Owner Safety Specifications (OSS) and client HSSE requirements. Promote a strong safety culture through visible field leadership, daily site presence, and the consistent application of Stop Work Authority for all personnel. Act as SNA's primary HSSE representative to the Owner, Goldwind, and their respective HSSE teams. Attend HSSE coordination meetings and walk-downs to ensure effective communication and collaboration on safety matters. Ensure compliance with all Saudi labor and HSE regulations, including restrictions on outdoor work during summer midday hours and the implementation of heat-stress controls. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in Health, Safety, Security, and Environment management. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage HSSE activities for complex industrial or construction projects. Strong understanding of Saudi labor and HSE regulations. Proven experience in developing and implementing HSSE plans and emergency response procedures. Work Environment This is a full-time position requiring on-site presence in Riyadh and Shaqra'. The role involves active participation in field operations and coordination with various stakeholders to ensure a safe working environment. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

9aa0c343092fc5bc.job_title: QA/RA Specialist Egypt Rest of MEA & South Africa
9aa0c343092fc5bc.description: About the Role Johnson & Johnson is seeking a QA/RA Specialist for Egypt, the Rest of MEA, and South Africa. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, supporting DePuy Synthes. The role involves executing Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs (QARA) activities across various MEA countries, including Egypt, South Africa, Libya, and Syria. Role Purpose and Context This specialist position contributes to maintaining regulatory compliance, supporting product lifecycle activities, and ensuring alignment with local health authority requirements. The role is integral to enabling timely patient access to DePuy Synthes orthopedic solutions while supporting quality systems and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the region. Key Responsibilities Support the preparation, submission, and maintenance of regulatory documentation for designated countries, ensuring alignment with local health authority requirements. Provide subject matter expertise regarding local regulatory and quality requirements for the scope countries. Assist in the execution of Quality Management System (QMS) processes, including document control, change management, and records maintenance. Coordinate with regional and global QARA partners to support product registrations, renewals, and post-market changes. Contribute to compliance activities related to audits, inspections, and internal quality reviews. Support the monitoring of regulatory changes and assess their potential impact on existing and future products in the target markets. Maintain accurate regulatory and quality records in designated systems to ensure inspection readiness. Collaborate cross-functionally with Commercial, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to support compliant product commercialization. Experience and Location Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. While the primary location is Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, the role supports operations across multiple cities including Jeddah and Makkah. This is a full-time position. Company Overview Johnson & Johnson is a global leader in healthcare, committed to improving the health and well-being of people worldwide. DePuy Synthes, a part of Johnson & Johnson, focuses on orthopedic solutions, providing innovative products and services to patients and healthcare professionals.

9ab7d716807ad7dd.description: About the Role MSI Qatar is seeking a GM, Planning & Control to lead planning and cost control for New Build and MRO projects within its shipyard. This full-time role focuses on maintaining the integrity of schedules, budgets, and progress monitoring to ensure timely project delivery and optimize resource utilization and cost efficiency. Role Purpose and Impact The primary objective of this position is to ensure effective planning and cost control across all projects. The GM, Planning & Control will drive coordination to align with contractual requirements, support accurate forecasting and reporting, and enable effective decision-making through reliable project controls. The role also promotes continuous improvement by standardizing planning and cost control practices and ensuring proper project close-out and documentation. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage all planning, scheduling, and cost control activities for NBR and MRO projects. Ensure the integrity of project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and progress measurement systems. Supervise and guide the planning and cost control team, setting clear KPIs to enhance performance. Develop and maintain project budgets aligned with approved estimates and financial objectives. Monitor actual costs, commitments, and forecasts, and analyze variances against approved budgets. Identify cost deviations, trends, and risks, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Establish and continuously improve planning and cost control procedures, tools, and reporting systems. Prepare and review key project control reports, including earned value, cash flow, and variance analysis. Coordinate with Project Management, Procurement, and P&C to ensure alignment of resources, materials, and project schedules. Develop resource plans and monitor utilization to avoid bottlenecks and optimize efficiency. Identify project risks related to schedule and cost, and support the implementation of mitigation strategies. Provide accurate and timely reporting to management on project performance, KPIs, and financial status. Support project recovery planning where deviations in schedule or cost are identified. Drive continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and enhancing planning and cost control practices. Support effective project close-out through proper documentation, final cost reporting, and performance evaluation. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in planning and cost control, preferably within a shipyard or similar heavy industry environment. Proven ability to lead and manage teams, setting clear performance indicators. Strong understanding of project management principles, scheduling software, and cost control methodologies. Experience in developing and maintaining project budgets, monitoring costs, and analyzing variances. Demonstrated ability to identify risks and implement corrective actions. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. This is a full-time position with a competitive, undisclosed salary.

9abe96d3581cb6a1.description: About the Role Jeddah Central Development Company (JCDC) is seeking a Corporate Finance & Transaction Advisory Director to lead its financial strategy. This full-time position, based in Jeddah or Makkah, requires a professional with over 10 years of experience. The Director will be responsible for driving investment and funding strategies, evaluating and supporting transaction execution, and optimizing value through strategic oversight. The role involves acting as a key advisor to the management team, ensuring financial decisions align with JCDC’s long-term goals and shareholder interests. Key Accountabilities Lead the development and refinement of JCDC’s Business Plan, Investment & Funding Strategy, and Detailed Funding Plan. Assess and implement strategies to optimize the balance sheet to improve Return on Invested Capital (ROIC). Prepare materials for the Investment and Funding Committee and implement directives from the committee. Advise the company’s Executive Management on investment and funding matters to ensure informed decision-making. Collaborate with JCDC’s shareholders on financial report development to ensure timely delivery. Deal Evaluation and Execution Collaborate with stakeholders to prepare for capital raising activities, ensuring all necessary documentation and strategies are in place. Develop compelling marketing materials to attract potential deals. Conduct pre-deal due diligence activities to assess the viability and risks of potential deals. Lead the development of deal-specific sensitivity analysis and scenario modeling to evaluate potential outcomes. Structure, negotiate, and close transactions to ensure favorable terms for the company. Value Creation and Optimization Monitor the company’s active and current investments to ensure expected performance. Contribute to the preparation of investment reports and performance updates for stakeholders. Analyze the company’s portfolio to identify potential opportunities for optimization and growth. Analyze and propose potential divestments or exit opportunities to the Deal Evaluation & Execution team. Assist with merger and acquisition (M&A) integration activities to achieve intended synergies and maximize predicted value. Strategy and Leadership Develop and direct the implementation of the Corporate Finance and Transactions department strategy, ensuring alignment with divisional strategy, JCDC’s vision, mission, and corporate objectives. Provide subject matter expertise and strategic counsel to JCDC leadership on corporate finance, investment, funding, and transaction matters. Manage the effective achievement of departmental objectives through leadership, setting individual objectives, managing performance, and developing and motivating the team. Lead talent development initiatives for the assigned department, collaborating with discipline experts and ensuring talent availability to fit business requirements. Financial Management and Compliance Oversee the consolidation and recommendation of the department budget, monitoring financial performance against the budget. Develop and lead the implementation of department policies, systems, processes, procedures, and controls to fulfill relevant procedural and legislative requirements. Lead change management through continuous improvement of department systems, processes, and practices, considering global standards and changes in the business environment. Ensure all department reports are prepared timely and accurately, meeting JCDC requirements, policies, and quality standards.

9aeb594f5add09ff.description: متابعة الحضور والانصراف والتأخير والغياب والتحقق من تسجيل البصمات، ومعالجة الملاحظات والاستثناءات بالتنسيق مع إدارة الموارد البشرية. إعداد ومراجعة كشوف الحضور والانصراف الشهرية، واستكمال التحقق والاعتمادات اللازمة ورفعها ضمن المواعيد المحددة لإعداد الرواتب. متابعة جداول الدوام والشفتات وأيام الراحة، والتأكد من تحديث التغييرات المعتمدة في النظام بشكل صحيح. متابعة طلبات الإجازات والمباشرات والاستئذان والعمل الإضافي، والتحقق من اكتمال المستندات والاعتمادات المطلوبة قبل استكمال الإجراء أو رفعه للجهة المختصة. استقبال استفسارات وطلبات الموظفين المتعلقة بالموارد البشرية، ورفعها عبر القنوات المعتمدة، ومتابعتها مع فرق الموارد البشرية المختصة حتى الإغلاق. تنسيق مباشرة الموظفين الجدد في الموقع، واستكمال بياناتهم ومستنداتهم، وتعريفهم بإجراءات الحضور وسياسات العمل ذات العلاقة. تحديث بيانات موظفي المستودعات وملفاتهم، ورصد النواقص في البيانات أو المستندات، ومتابعة استكمالها مع الموظفين وفرق الموارد البشرية المختصة. رصد ملاحظات الانضباط والمخالفات في موقع العمل، وتوثيق المعلومات الداعمة ورفع الحالات إلى إدارة الموارد البشرية لاستكمال المراجعة والإجراءات النظامية. متابعة حضور العمالة التابعة لشركات توفير العمالة، ومطابقة الأعداد الفعلية مع الطلبات المعتمدة، وتجهيز كشوف الحضور واستكمال التوقيعات والسجلات المطلوبة. التنسيق مع مشرفي ومديري المستودعات بشأن احتياجات الموظفين والشؤون الإدارية المرتبطة بهم، وإعداد تقارير دورية بالحالات المعلقة وملاحظات الحضور ونواقص المستندات والموضوعات التي تتطلب المعالجة. المحافظة على سرية بيانات الموظفين وضمان التعامل مع السجلات وبيانات الحضور والملفات الوظيفية وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة وضوابط الصلاحيات. تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى ذات صلة بطبيعة العمل يتم تكليفه بها من قبل الإدارة المباشرة أو الإدارة المعنية بما يخدم مصلحة العمل ويضمن استمرارية العمليات. الالتزام بالسياسات الداخلية وإجراءات العمل ولوائح الشركة والمعايير المعتمدة..

9a2655cd55e1e865.description: About the Role Stranger Soccer is expanding its global operations and is seeking an Operator & License Owner to establish, manage, and expand its football platform in Riyadh. This full-time role involves building and operating a local football initiative with the goal of increasing accessibility to the sport within the city. The position is suited for individuals with an entrepreneurial approach and a strong interest in football. Role Context and Objectives The Operator & License Owner will be responsible for leading the growth of Stranger Soccer in Riyadh. This includes developing local partnerships, managing operational aspects, and cultivating an active community of players. The role offers autonomy in shaping local operations while leveraging established systems, expertise, and support from the Singapore headquarters. Key Responsibilities Launch and expand Stranger Soccer operations in Riyadh. Establish partnerships with football venues and secure appropriate playing locations. Recruit, coordinate, and provide support to Official Hosts and local team members. Implement marketing strategies to attract players and foster community growth. Oversee game operations to ensure a positive player experience. Identify opportunities for enhancing and expanding local operations. Headquarters Support The successful candidate will receive support from Stranger Soccer's Singapore headquarters, which includes: Access to a technology platform for application management, payments, and operations. Established operating systems and processes. Ongoing guidance across operational, marketing, and growth aspects. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated passion for football. Entrepreneurial drive and a focus on creating local impact. About Stranger Soccer Stranger Soccer facilitates accessible and flexible football experiences through its mobile application, allowing players to find nearby games, book spots, and participate. Founded in Singapore, the company operates in over 10 cities globally and has organized more than 100,000 games. This role contributes to bringing this experience to local communities.

9a3adf40ccb9628f.description: About the Role Modern Mills Company is seeking an Officer Safety to join their team in Makkah, specifically in Al Jumum. This full-time role is crucial for maintaining a safe and healthy workplace by implementing, monitoring, and enforcing occupational health and safety (OHS) standards, policies, and procedures. The Safety Officer will identify hazards, conduct inspections, deliver safety training, and ensure compliance with legal and company safety requirements to prevent accidents, injuries, and occupational illnesses. Key Responsibilities Implement occupational health and safety (OHS) policies, procedures, and standards across the workplace. Conduct regular inspections, audits, and risk assessments to identify hazards, unsafe conditions, and unsafe practices, ensuring timely corrective actions. Monitor compliance with local regulations, company safety policies, and international safety standards. Deliver safety inductions, awareness sessions, and training for employees, contractors, and visitors. Investigate accidents, incidents, and near misses, prepare reports with root cause analysis, and recommend preventive measures. Ensure personal protective equipment (PPE) is available, properly maintained, and correctly used. Coordinate emergency response and fire evacuation drills, ensuring first aid and firefighting equipment is always ready. Report safety performance to management, including fire pump readings and fire alarm system status, and recommend continuous improvements. Promote a strong safety culture by encouraging safe behaviors at all levels of the organization. Qualifications and Experience 1-3 year of experience in a safety-related role. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Al Jumum, Makkah. The role involves working within the Modern Mills Company environment to ensure adherence to all safety protocols.

9a501a1a2980ff9f.company_name: شركة غسان احمد السليمان لتجارة المفروشات
9a501a1a2980ff9f.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث محل مأكولات الجودة الغذائية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يتولى هذا الدور مسؤولية وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق، وتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، ووضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم واحتياجاتهم. متابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية المحتملة. تقييم نتائج أعمال مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. اقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لتحسين الأداء. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ التقارير في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع العملاء والزملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتقديم التوصيات بشكل احترافي. مكان العمل ونوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في محل مأكولات الجودة الغذائية للقيام بالمهام المحددة. عن محل مأكولات الجودة الغذائية محل مأكولات الجودة الغذائية هو مؤسسة متخصصة في تقديم المأكولات، ويسعى لتعزيز فريقه بأفراد يساهمون في تحقيق أهدافه البيعية والتسويقية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة الوظيفية.

9ad7bfcf970beb03.description: About the Role Dhahran Techno Valley is seeking an Oracle Developer to join its team in Dhahran, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves supporting, maintaining, and enhancing the Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and custom applications hosted within the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) tenancy. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Context and Scope The Oracle landscape includes Financials, Procurement, HCM/Payroll, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Customer Experience (CX), Project Management (PPM), and Oracle Analytics / Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI). Additionally, the developer will serve as the internal technical owner for two custom solutions in OCI: a CRM application and a ZATCA e-invoicing integration, ensuring their stability, compliance, and continuous improvement without reliance on external vendors. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain reports, extracts, and dashboards using BI Publisher, OTBI, HCM Extracts, Oracle Analytics Cloud, and FDI for various business functions. Build and support integrations between Oracle Fusion and internal/third-party systems using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP APIs, FBDI, and HDL. Develop and maintain extensions and personalizations using Visual Builder Studio, Application Composer, and sandboxes. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، مع ضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن 9a4261ba49d3c04a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أوبا ستايل في الرياض عن أمين مخزن للانضمام إلى فريقها بدوام كامل. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة استلام وتخزين وصرف المواد والسلع داخل المستودع، بالإضافة إلى المشاركة في عمليات الجرد. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمبتدئين الذين يسعون لبناء مسيرتهم المهنية في إدارة المستودعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد والسلع الواردة إلى المستودع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المحددة في طلبات الشراء أو التوريد أو العينات. تنظيم وترتيب البضائع والمعدات والمواد الموردة، ووضعها في الأماكن المخصصة لها، وتثبيت البيانات الخاصة بها. تحضير المواد وتجهيزها وصرفها للجهات المعنية بموجب سندات صرف، وفقاً لآلية الصرف المعتمدة. تحديد الاحتياجات من السلع والمواد عند وصول المخزون إلى حد الطلب، وحفظ جميع معاملات الإدخالات والإخراجات المتعلقة بالمستودع. المشاركة الفعالة في عمليات جرد المخزون ومطابقة نتائج الجرد الفعلي مع أرصدة الدفاتر والسجلات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال أمناء المخازن أو إدارة المستودعات. القدرة على استلام وفحص المواد بدقة. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لترتيب وتخزين البضائع. القدرة على التعامل مع سندات الصرف وحفظ السجلات. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المستودع لإدارة العمليات اليومية بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: الرياض. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق مؤسسة أوبا ستايل.

9a17d7547d57112a.description: Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. We were set up for problems that do not fit the large-firm model, and we take on a limited number of mandates at a time. The principals who scope the work are the ones who deliver it. About the role This is a permanent, full-time role for someone at the start of a career in advisory, working from our Riyadh office on a hybrid arrangement. You would support the principals across live mandates, which means sitting in the room where the work is scoped and seeing how a view gets formed and defended. You carry real pieces of each engagement from the first week: the research behind a market question, the model that tests a client's assumptions, the note that records what was agreed. We are looking for someone who wants to learn the trade by doing it rather than by watching it. What you will do Build the evidence base for a mandate: market data, competitor positions, and the economics of a client's portfolio, pulled together into something a principal can read in ten minutes. Draft and maintain working documents (issue notes, interview guides, board papers) and keep versions straight as a mandate moves forward. Sit in on client interviews and workshops, take the notes that matter, and turn them into a short written summary the same day. Prepare the numbers behind a recommendation, including simple models and sensitivity checks, and be able to explain where each figure came from. Keep the engagement's own administration in order: action lists, follow-ups with client teams, and the record of what has been decided and by whom. What we need from you A bachelor's degree, and a genuine interest in how organizations make decisions about strategy, capital and structure. Clear writing in English. Arabic is a strong advantage for client interviews and for reading local material in the original. Comfort with spreadsheets and slides, and the patience to check your own numbers before someone else does. Enough structure to juggle two or three workstreams without losing one, and the habit of flagging a problem early rather than late. Discretion. Much of what you will see and hear inside a client's organization does not travel. What success looks like In the first six to twelve months, you would become the person a principal trusts with the groundwork on a mandate: the research is done properly, the numbers hold up, and the note is written before it is asked for. A good first year means you have contributed to real client decisions, not prepared material that sat unused. It also means you can explain the logic of a piece of analysis to a client team without reaching for the slides. Clients should come to recognize your name as someone whose work they can rely on. How we work Principals scope every mandate and stay with it through delivery, so the person who defines the question is the person you will work with on the answer. Staffing is decided by the principal running the engagement, and sign-off sits with them too. You would be expected to form a view and say it, including when it disagrees with a draft on the table. Escalation is short: if something is unclear or going wrong, you raise it with the principal leading the work directly. As you build judgment, more of the client contact comes your way. What the role offers This is a permanent, full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on a hybrid arrangement. You would see mandates from the inside across corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, and organization and talent, working alongside principals rather than at a distance from them. The exposure is broad because the firm is deliberately narrow in what it takes on. You will learn how boards and committees reach decisions, and how a recommendation is tested once it meets management. Who tends to do well here The people who settle in quickly tend to be writers first and presenters second: they would rather get the argument right on the page than perform it in a room. They are comfortable working in a client's own vocabulary and asking the simple question everyone else has skipped. They like being accountable for a number and will chase down the reason it moved. Most of all, they are curious about why an institution behaves the way it does, and patient enough to find out.

9a61873cf323e576.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان الامتثال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية التصميم الكلية وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة البيئية. الإشراف على أعمال صيانة المعدات وتصليحها بهدف تقليل العادم والمخلفات، والتأكد من سير العمليات وفقاً لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مراقبة العمليات وإجراء جولات تفقدية لمواقع التشغيل والعمليات لضمان اتباع معايير سلامة البيئة، وتقديم النصح والمشورة اللازمة في هذا الشأن. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. فهم عميق لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وتطبيقاتها في المشاريع الهندسية. القدرة على تحليل العمليات وتقديم حلول لتحسين الأداء البيئي والسلامة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم المشورة وإعداد التقارير. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. المعرفة بأحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير السلامة والجودة البيئية في جميع عمليات الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.
